metadata.question: Was the area of aritifical land built off the coast of Jakarata Bay greater than 800 hectares as of 2021?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use JRC Global Surface Water YearlyClassification (JRC/GSW1_4/YearlyClassification) for years 1984–2013 (baseline water) and 2021 (current). AOI is a polygon covering Jakarta Bay and adjacent offshore area near 106.64–107.00 E, -6.28 to -5.95 lat.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed. Use JRC yearly waterClass; treat values >1 as water, >0 as valid data.
3. Logic: New land = pixels that were water at least once pre-2014 and are not water in 2021. Validate collections exist (C1), ensure valid pixels in 2021 (C2), and check for null/NaN results (C3). Otherwise compare area against 800 ha to answer A/B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const aoi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
      [[106.64, -6.28], [106.64, -5.95], [107.00, -5.95], [107.00, -6.28]]
    ]);
    const preStart = 1984;
    const preEnd = 2013;
    const targetYear = 2021;
    const thresholdHa = 800;
    const scaleCount = 60; // for counts, small AOI; fine-grained but light
    const scaleArea = 30;  // area at native GSW resolution

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const gsw = ee.ImageCollection('JRC/GSW1_4/YearlyClassification');
    const preCol = gsw.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(preStart, preEnd, 'year')).select('waterClass');
    const y2021Col = gsw.filter(ee.Filter.eq('year', targetYear)).select('waterClass');

    const preSize = await preCol.size().getInfo();
    const y2021Size = await y2021Col.size().getInfo();

    if (!preSize || !y2021Size) {
      console.log(`Pre ${preStart}-${preEnd} Images: ${preSize || 0}`);
      console.log(`${targetYear} Images: ${y2021Size || 0}`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing
    const preWaterAny = preCol.map(img => img.gt(1)).max(); // water (seasonal or permanent) any time pre-2014
    const y2021 = y2021Col.first();
    const valid2021 = y2021.gt(0);       // has data
    const water2021 = y2021.gt(1);       // water (seasonal or permanent)
    const candidate = preWaterAny.and(valid2021);
    const newLand = candidate.and(water2021.not()); // reclaimed: was water before, not water in 2021

    // Counts and area
    const countValid2021 = await ee.Image.constant(1).updateMask(valid2021)
      .reduceRegion({reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: scaleCount, maxPixels: 1e9})
      .get('constant').getInfo();

    if (!countValid2021 || countValid2021 === 0) {
      console.log(`Pre ${preStart}-${preEnd} Images: ${preSize}`);
      console.log(`${targetYear} Images: ${y2021Size}`);
      console.log(`2021 Valid Pixels: ${countValid2021 || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    const countCandidate = await ee.Image.constant(1).updateMask(candidate)
      .reduceRegion({reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: scaleCount, maxPixels: 1e9})
      .get('constant').getInfo();

    const countNewLand = await ee.Image.constant(1).updateMask(newLand)
      .reduceRegion({reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: scaleCount, maxPixels: 1e9})
      .get('constant').getInfo();

    const areaNewLand_m2 = await ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(newLand)
      .reduceRegion({reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: scaleArea, maxPixels: 1e9})
      .get('area').getInfo();

    // 4. Validation & Final Answer
    const areaHa = areaNewLand_m2 ? (areaNewLand_m2 / 10000.0) : null;
    if (areaHa === null || !isFinite(areaHa) || areaHa < 0) {
      console.log(`Pre ${preStart}-${preEnd} Images: ${preSize}`);
      console.log(`${targetYear} Images: ${y2021Size}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`Pre ${preStart}-${preEnd} Images: ${preSize}`);
    console.log(`${targetYear} Images: ${y2021Size}`);
    console.log(`2021 Valid Pixels: ${Math.round(countValid2021)}`);
    console.log(`Candidates (pre-water & valid in 2021): ${Math.round(countCandidate || 0)}`);
    console.log(`New Land Pixels: ${Math.round(countNewLand || 0)}`);
    console.log(`New Land Area (ha): ${areaHa.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(areaHa > thresholdHa ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
